newsitem.title: UK: GrandMet, Brent row to be resolved - paper.
newsitem.headline: GrandMet, Brent row to be resolved - paper.

text.p: The legal battle between Grand Metropolitan and Brent Walker Group is expected to be resolved on Monday, according to a report in the Sunday Times.

Accounting firm Arthur Andersen, acting as arbitrator, will announce its verdict on whether Brent Walker overpaid when it gave GrandMet 685 million stg for William Hill, the betting shop chain, in 1989, the paper said.

Brent Walker has claimed that it should have been repaid about 200 million stg of the purchase price, and has withheld 50 million stg of the William Hill purchase price. With interest, the withheld sum now totals some 80 million stg, the paper said.
